findings: One independently testable behavior: the ecology illusion layer (section 20) — bus-driven schooling plus cross-species reactions, all one signal-keyed opt-in mechanism (CreatureDef.ecology over WorldSignal), proved by a single node scenario; schooling is not an independently shippable feature here, since its acceptance (section 48 schools parting around the player) is signal-driven and is verified inside the same scenario, and the parent's single criterion with two shared subsystems admits no strict-subset split, matching ST-02's decomposition note.

Changed responsibilities <= 3: (1) schooling/flocking for the ambient school fixture with bounded local perception and parting around the player; (2) the reaction layer — the six cheap rules (flee, scavenge, orient to currents, hide before colossal event, predators attack ambient prey, zone quiet before major events) are variants of one parameterized distance/strength predicate mechanism, which the required unit tests confirm; (3) a conditional minimal extension of src/creatures/senses.ts only if a signal type is missing, bounded by the item's falsification clause (a reaction needing a global state read is falsified and routed to fix-planning).

Subsystems named are 2 (creature simulation, world signal bus); no umbrella labels, no hidden cross-story dependencies: currents come from the existing CurrentField in src/systems/CurrentSystem.ts (section 64), throttling and the collision system are WI-02a's already-accepted scope.
AC-cf-ecology is retained verbatim from ST-02; siblings WI-02a/WI-02b hold AC-cf-core and AC-cf-render, so the leaf union covers all three story criteria.

depends_on [WI-02a, WI-02b] is correct: the neutral school/forager fixtures, runtime, and scenario harness come from WI-02a, and the 'schools are visible' browser check requires WI-02b's renderers (per ST-02's dependency note); no ancestor or descendant dependency.

Verification is focused, not a whole-game check: one node scenario with >= 3 distinct reactions, state assertions, and the standard failure trace from the section 30 harness; predicate unit tests; a performance check that reactions stay within the throttling budget at capped ambient counts; a short browser check for visible schools.

Handoff is concrete and verified: request sections 20, 48, 61, 63, 64 exist and match the spec's content; WorldSignalBus is at src/creatures/senses.ts:66 as cited; the reusable harness exists at src/sim/scenario.ts, so 'extend, do not create a second rig' is actionable; seeded determinism maps to util/rng.ts with section 61's split (school formation and idle variation seeded, critical behavior deterministic).

Assumption: the current bus carries only the four section 63 types (noise, light, sonar, injury), so 'predator proximity', 'recent kill', and 'scheduled large event' channels rely on the item's stated minimal senses.ts extension or existing sim events; the zone-quiet reaction's event key must remain a local zone/event state, and the falsification clause (no global state read, no direct player references) bounds the escape risk.

Assumption: the item implements 6 of section 20's 8 listed tricks; 'friendly species investigate resource nodes' belongs to section 21's friendly creatures (ST-03) and 'carcass particles attract species' is a particle-driven variant subsumed by the scavenger-approaches-kills rule; the criterion does not name specific tricks, so this is not scope shrinkage.
Non-goals keep it an illusion, not a simulator: no population dynamics or food-web model, no roster species or authored set pieces (those are ST-03/ST-04), consistent with section 20's first line.
summary: WI-02c is a correctly bounded leaf: one behavior (the section 20 ecology illusion — bus-driven schooling and cross-species reactions as one signal-keyed layer, verified headlessly by a node scenario), two changed subsystems (creature simulation, world signal bus), at most three changed responsibilities, a verbatim parent criterion, correct WI-02a/WI-02b dependencies (fixtures/harness and the renderer for the visible-schools check), focused scenario + predicate + performance evidence, and a verified fresh-session handoff (sections 20/48/61/63/64, WorldSignalBus at src/creatures/senses.ts:66, existing src/sim/scenario.ts harness, CurrentSystem fields, seeded rng).
